title: Bench Server Implementation Plan
summary: Task-by-task implementation plan for a local NetHack bench server: SQLite store, scheduler, worker subprocesses, HTTP API, and MCP client.
notes: Implementation plan rather than a spec, but it fixes technical contracts (port 8765, DB path, checkpoint sizes, module responsibilities, worker import restriction), so SPEC is the closest fit at low confidence. Classified from the first 50 lines plus the Global Constraints, File Structure, and Review Focus sections.
